metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace exposing the cc-enslaver discipline plugin.

plugins.name: cc-enslaver
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin and LLM-agnostic rule pack that enforces systematic thinking, verified citations, and root-cause analysis — eliminating reactive, lazy AI behavior. v0.23 adds rule 12 (repo-wide sync) + a hard TL;DR length contract. rule 12 makes 'done' mean 'every repo-wide reference moved with the edit': projects register co-update invariants in .claude/cc-enslaver/sync-gate.toml (when/require globs); the new Stop layer (i) blocks an edit-turn done-claim whose when-group matched with no require-side edit and no explicit sync-acknowledgement marker (同步核对 / sync-check) — per-project opt-in, failing-open. Its active half is the new repo-refresh skill: an on-demand whole-repo sweep (docs + code) for stale, outdated, redundant, wrong, and drifted content with file:line evidence. The v0.20 tldr closing gains a 160-char-per-item cap at Stop layer (h): one sentence per item (cause, action, outcome); several things → one short line each. v0.23 also fixes two pre-existing HIGH defects found by a live-state E2E audit: production payloads carry no turn_count (the edit-gated Stop layers had never fired outside the test suite — now driven by an edited_since_last_stop flag + a synthesized per-session stop counter that also restores the grace window), and a session-state lost-update race under parallel hook processes (now cross-process file lock + atomic save). Prior: v0.22 added write-time content detectors rules 10 (no non-essential hardcoding) and 11 (no non-essential path dependency), PreToolUse-only with a why-comment escape hatch and prose-doc/lockfile exemptions; v0.22.1 sharpened rule 06 (Check 2b: aggregate-equal is not unchanged) and rule 09 (bulk-mechanical-edit discipline + closed-set guards); v0.22.2 added the version-drift gate pinning this very file to plugin.json. English is the i18n skeleton and source of truth (rules/ + prompts/ at the root, default injection); Chinese is a first-class translation (rules/zh/ + prompts/zh/, CC_ENSLAVER_LANG=zh), with drift CI-blocked by i18n_check.py + test_i18n_sync.py.
